left_margin_red_stars.description: A series of red 8-pointed stars positioned in the left margin, each marking the beginning of a new text section or paragraph grouping. Approximately 8 stars are visible, evenly spaced vertically down the left margin. Each star has a central red dot or circle with 8 points radiating outward. They function as visual paragraph markers or section flags, equivalent to illuminated capitals in other manuscripts.
left_margin_red_stars.color: Deep red (vermilion or red lead). The stars are the ONLY color element on this otherwise monochrome text page — making them extremely visually prominent against the cream parchment. No fill color other than red; the points and body are solidly red-painted.

right_margin_red_star.description: A smaller red star or asterisk mark at the right margin, approximately mid-folio. Possibly an annotation or correction marker added by a reader. Similar red pigment to the left stars but smaller and less formal.
right_margin_red_star.color: Same deep red as left margin stars. Smaller scale.

top_green_smear.description: A faint green wash visible at the very top edge of the folio. This is likely bleed-through or offset from a painted illustration on an adjacent page, not an intentional element of f105v itself.
top_green_smear.color: Pale/faded medium green. Very faint — probably transferred pigment.

ruled_line_bottom.description: A light horizontal ruled line visible beneath the dense text block, approximately at y=940. This line may mark the boundary of the writing area or separate a final sub-section.
